purpose: Determine minimum sufficient history length (0..4) of exact scalar affine autoregressions without supplying order to the inference engine

retrieval_log.surface: Local execution Python3 Fraction exact Gaussian elimination
retrieval_log.result: 80 assertions passed; all five minimal orders and 60 held-out outputs correct; first test of short-history control failed because [0,1,2] actually identifies affine y=x+1; corrected to [0,1] before final execution.

negative_controls: Two observations [0,1] insufficient for unique first-order parameters; no fit promoted
Order-4 authored recurrence with trailing zero lag weights has minimum observable order 2
Single tampering in an order-2 trajectory cannot be fit by stationary affine order<=4 over 28 examples
Constant input history makes lag-4 coefficients rank-deficient
interpretation: The shortest uniquely fitting autoregression among orders 0–4 is identified for assistant-generated exact trajectories. Observable minimum order can differ from nominal authored equation order.
limitations: Not unrestricted memory discovery: restricted to affine constant-coefficient scalar recurrences
Training and testing share generating mechanism; independent unseen dataset not provided
No connection to RH/Navier–Stokes theorem validation or authorship inference
